## How to use WP Bakery Page Builder with the Everest Forms?

<https://docs.everestforms.net/docs/how-to-use-wp-bakery-page-builder-with-the-everest-forms/>

**Note**: First, you need to install the **WP Bakery Page Builder **Plugin on your site.

- To begin with, you need the Everest Forms plugin.

- Now go to **Everest Forms > Add-ons > All Features.**

- Search **WP Bakery **module and activate it.

- Go to the WordPress dashboard, click on **Pages**, find the page you want to edit, and then click on **Edit with WPBakery Page Builder.**

- Click the plus **icon **to add the element.

- Next, click on the **Everest Forms** section, and you will see the Everest Forms **widget **for WPBakery.

- After clicking on the widget, a **popup **will appear to select a form. Choose the desired form and click the **Save Changes **button.

- Now, you can customize the form layouts. You also have the option to **clone**, **copy**, or **edit **the Everest Forms.

---

## How to use Oxygen Builder with the Everest Forms?

<https://docs.everestforms.net/docs/how-to-use-oxygen-builder-with-the-everest-forms/>

**Note**: First, you need to install the **Oxygen Builder **Plugin on your site.

- To begin with, you need the Everest Forms plugin.

- Now go to **Everest Forms > Add-ons > All Features.**

- Search **Oxygen **module and activate it.

- Go to the WordPress dashboard, click on **Pages**, find the page you want to edit, and then click on **Edit with Oxygen.**

- Click the plus **icon **in the top left corner, as shown below.

- Next, in the **sidebar**, you will see the **Everest Forms** option. Click on the **dropdown **arrow next to it.

- Click on the **Everest Forms **block and select a form from the desired section. There are two sections: **Primary **and **Advanced**. In the Primary section, you can style the **Form Container, Labels, and Submit Button.**

- In the Advanced options, you can style the borders, layout, size, spacing, and also add custom CSS and JavaScript.

---

## How to use Divi Builder with Everest Forms?

<https://docs.everestforms.net/docs/how-to-use-divi-builder-with-everest-forms/>

**Note:** First, you need to install the **Divi Builder **theme on your site.

- To begin with, you need the Everest Forms plugin.

- Now go to **Everest Forms > Add-ons > All Features.**

- Search **Divi Builder **module and activate it.

- Go to the WordPress dashboard, click on **Pages**, find the page you want to edit, and then click on **Edit with Divi.**

- To begin, after clicking on **Edit with Divi**, the Divi Builder page will open. You can add a new row, click the **plus **icon to insert a new module, and then select the **Everest Forms **block.

- After clicking on the Everest Forms block, a **popup **will appear, allowing you to **select **and **customize **your **forms**. The popup includes three main options: **Content, Design, and Advanced.**

- In Design, you can see the options available for sizing, spacing, animation, and transformation.

- In Advanced, you will find options to add Custom CSS, Visibility, Transitions, Positions, and Scroll Effects.

## How to use Bricks Builder theme with Everest Forms?

<https://docs.everestforms.net/docs/how-to-use-bricks-builder-theme-with-everest-forms/>

**Note**: First, you need to install the **Brick Builder **theme on your site.

- To begin with, you need the Everest Forms plugin.

- Now go to **Everest Forms > Add-ons > All Features.**

- Search **Bricks Builder **module and activate it.

- Go to the WordPress dashboard, click on **Pages**, find the page you want to edit, and then click on **Edit with Bricks.**

- After clicking on **Edit with Bricks**, the Bricks editor interface will open. On the left **sidebar**, you will find the Everest Forms **section**.

- After that, drag and drop the Everest Forms block, then select the form you wish to style.

## How to use Beaver Builder with Everest Forms?

<https://docs.everestforms.net/docs/how-to-use-beaver-builder-with-everest-forms/>

**Note:** First, you need to install the Beaver Builder **Plugin **on your site.

- To begin with, you need the Everest Forms plugin.

- Now go to **Everest Forms > Add-ons > All Features.**

- Search **Beaver Builder **add-on and install it.

- Go to the WordPress dashboard, click on **Pages**, find the page you want to edit, and then click on **Beaver Builder**.

- Click on the **Plus **icon at the **top right **corner.

- The sidebar navigation menu will appear, where you will find a section for Everest Forms.

- Next, drag and drop the Everest Forms blocks and select the desired forms.

- After selecting the form, you can customize its styling according to your preferences.
